address.docs:
**int**: The i²c address of the sensor. See [I²C Addresses](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/as5600#as5600_i2c_addresses) for more information.

*See also: [AS5600 12-Bit Magnetic Position Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/as5600#configuration-variables)*

dir_pin.docs:
**int**: The pin connected to the AS5600's direction pin. See [Direction](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/as5600#direction) for more information.

*See also: [AS5600 12-Bit Magnetic Position Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/as5600#configuration-variables)*

direction.docs:
**string**: The direction that the magnet should rotate to increase values. Used in combination with the **dir_pin**.

*See also: [AS5600 12-Bit Magnetic Position Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/as5600#configuration-variables)*

end_position.docs:
**int**: The raw position that should be considered the end (e.g. 180deg) of the allowable rotation range. Mutually exclusive with **range**. See [Position / Range](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/as5600#as5600_position_range).

*See also: [AS5600 12-Bit Magnetic Position Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/as5600#configuration-variables)*

id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: Manually specify the ID for this AS5600 Hub.

*See also: [AS5600 12-Bit Magnetic Position Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/as5600#configuration-variables)*

power_mode.docs:
**string**: The power mode to run the sensor. Note: When **watchdog** is enabled, it will switch the device to `low3` when there is not much change in position.

*See also: [AS5600 12-Bit Magnetic Position Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/as5600#configuration-variables)*

range.docs:
**int**: The allowable rotation range from the **start_position**. Mutually exclusive with **end_position**. See [Position / Range](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/as5600#as5600_position_range).

*See also: [AS5600 12-Bit Magnetic Position Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/as5600#configuration-variables)*

start_position.docs:
**int**: The raw position that should be considered the start (i.e. `0`  ). See [Position / Range](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/as5600#as5600_position_range).

*See also: [AS5600 12-Bit Magnetic Position Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/as5600#configuration-variables)*

watchdog.docs:
**boolean**: Whether to enable the watchdog that puts the chip into low power mode 3. Check the datasheet for more information. Defaults to `off`.

*See also: [AS5600 12-Bit Magnetic Position Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/as5600#configuration-variables)*

as5600_id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: Manually specify the ID of the [AS5600 Hub](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/as5600#as5600-component) you want to use this sensor.

*See also: [AS5600 12-Bit Magnetic Position Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/as5600#configuration-variables)*

gain.docs:
Information about the automatic gain control. Typically for diagnostic purposes. The datasheet says this will be between 0-255 when powered by 5v and between 0-128 when powered by 3.3v. Ideally the value should be close to the middle of the respective range.

*See also: [AS5600 12-Bit Magnetic Position Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/as5600#configuration-variables)*

magnitude.docs:
Information about the detected magnitude. Typically for diagnostic purposes. The expected scale does not appear to be defined in the datasheet, however, AMS provides a [user guide](https://ams.com/documents/20143/36005/Position%20Sensors_UG000359_1-00.pdf/65a99825-c115-f2f0-9167-6efad8e27c20) which contains pictures that show it as a scale between `0` and `3000`. Typically this value is seen somewhere in the neighborhood of `2100` for a well positioned magnet.

*See also: [AS5600 12-Bit Magnetic Position Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/as5600#configuration-variables)*

out_of_range_mode.docs:
**string**: How to treat out of range values. Only applicable if configured for a range less than 360 degrees. Defaults to `min_max`. See [Out of Range Mode](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/as5600#out-of-range-mode).

*See also: [AS5600 12-Bit Magnetic Position Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/as5600#configuration-variables)*

raw_position.docs:
Reports the raw (un-scaled, un-filtered) position of the magnet.

*See also: [AS5600 12-Bit Magnetic Position Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/as5600#configuration-variables)*

status.docs:
Information about the magnet status. Typically for diagnostic purposes. See [Magnet Status](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/as5600#magnet-status)

*See also: [AS5600 12-Bit Magnetic Position Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/as5600#configuration-variables)*

update_interval.docs:
**[Time](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#time)**: The interval to check the sensor. Defaults to `60s`.

*See also: [AS5600 12-Bit Magnetic Position Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/as5600#configuration-variables)*
